_meta.description: Adstock-style grid from ONE window item: a for_each zips an integer label axis with a decay axis, so a single WIN_EWMA item expands in place into three exponentially weighted revenue columns (revenue_ad30 at decay 0.3, revenue_ad50 at 0.5, revenue_ad70 at 0.7). The label axis carries the label text because a placeholder cannot compute it from the decay. Predict reports the fan-out and counts the expanded items against MaxDerivedColumns.
_meta.name: win_ewma_for_each
